aggregation.internal: patient_then_pathway; patients equally weighted; PCC uses Fisher-z patient aggregation

metrics.pcc: Pearson correlation; n>=3 and both variances>0; clip to [-0.999999,0.999999] before Fisher-z aggregation
metrics.nrmse_sigma_train: raw_rmse / frozen train sigma; expected to equal z_rmse
metrics.ssim: 7x7 standard grid SSIM when rectangular-grid occupancy>=0.90; otherwise masked_SSIM_PFMval over fully occupied 7x7 local windows
metrics.moran: rook adjacency at the minimum positive coordinate step; report truth, prediction, prediction-minus-truth delta, absolute delta and signed-error Moran I

ssim.data_range_source: frozen training z-score scale, fixed as [-3,+3] sigma span; never fitted from XZY

bootstrap.huber: descriptive per-pathway deltas only because identifiers are absent

na_rules.ssim: no fully occupied 7x7 window or unreliable coordinates
na_rules.moran: fewer than 3 observations, zero variance or no rook edges
